notes: Cloud tasks: if the app closes, the PC sleeps or the connection drops while a cloud task works, it now picks the task up again by itself and shows everything it did, with its files.

Cloud tasks: a task that stopped at its spending cap continues when you send a message (the cap is raised for you). Errors Anthropic is still retrying no longer stop the task, and running out of API credits says so plainly.
Cloud tasks: every file the task makes is now downloaded (before, files that appeared a few seconds late were missed), and files with the same name no longer overwrite each other.
Fixed: cloud chats that changed files could fail to open. Fixed: with no Claude key, cloud mode no longer quietly runs on the PC instead.
Inside Shivo Labs, the hub's Settings can open these settings directly.
